profile.description:
Beachwood Integrative Equine Therapy offers private healing intensives that support anxiety, stress, trauma, and major life transitions through a whole-person, nervous-system–based approach.

Beachwood specializes in Integrative Equine Therapy (IET)—a guided, experiential modality that works through the horse–human connection to support regulation, clarity, and meaningful change. This work is relationship-based, intentionally private, and carefully facilitated.

Beachwood serves adults, professionals, and families through private intensives only (never groups) at centers in Rhode Island, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Florida, and California.

This channel shares insights from Integrative Equine Therapists and observations from working alongside horses, offering a grounded perspective on nervous-system health and whole-person healing.

Learn more at https://beachwoodri.org/intensives

频道名称：Beachwood Integrative Equine Therapy
频道简介：Beachwood Integrative Equine Therapy offers private healing intensives that support anxiety, stress, trauma, and major life transitions through a whole-person, nervous-system–based approach.

Beachwood specializes in Integrative Equine Therapy (IET)—a guided, experiential modality that works through the horse–human connection to support regulation, clarity, and meaningful change. This work is relationship-based, intentionally private, and carefully facilitated.

Beachwood serves adults, professionals, and families through private intensives only (never groups) at centers in Rhode Island, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Florida, and California.

This channel shares insights from Integrative Equine Therapists and observations from working alongside horses, offering a grounded perspective on nervous-system health and whole-person healing.

Learn more at https://beachwoodri.org/intensives
